verdict.rationale: BILL has a public developer platform (v3 API, webhooks, sandbox, recipes, Elements) that AI-native builders could use, and it even documents an MCP docs server for AI coding tools, but there is no evidence of official language-specific SDKs (e.g., Python/JS/Node client libraries) — only REST API docs and a discoverable OpenAPI attempt that 404s. missing for 10: official SDKs/client libraries in specific languages, published OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation of SDK usage.
